FAQ

Selling surplus PSA tape and label rolls

What PSA rolls do you buy?

We buy pressure sensitive adhesive (PSA) backed rolls: label stock in slit and master rolls, BOPP, PE and PET plastic tape, double sided tape, medical tape, heat shrink tape, paper tape, metallized film labels, overlaminates and silicone release liner.

Do you buy self wound and supported rolls?

Yes, both. We also buy carrier and facestock webs, and many PSA-backed metals and fabrics.

Which industries do your PSA rolls come from?

We buy rolls from tape and label converters, release liner and facestock makers, flexible packaging converters and slitters, and medical and pharmaceutical suppliers.

Do you buy surplus release liner on its own?

Yes. Silicone release liner, paper or film, is one of the materials we buy most often.

How do I sell my surplus tape and label rolls?

Send us the product type, adhesive and liner if you know them, the gross weight on hand, your location and a few photos. As your roll buyer, we'll get back to you with a proposal.

How fast can you pick up?

We pick up full and partial trailer loads of surplus rolls across North America, usually within 48 to 72 hours.
